user_query: Analyze the supplied amino-acid sequence, report sequence properties, closest Swiss-Prot homologs and evidence-supported function, GO/localization annotations, and any domain clues. Clearly distinguish homology inference from curated evidence.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: IF-3 binds to the 30S ribosomal subunit and shifts the equilibrium between 70S ribosomes and their 50S and 30S subunits in favor of the free subunits, thus enhancing the availability of 30S subunits on which protein synthesis initiation begins.
